questions.stem_text: Which of the following is an accurate statement of the money supply in the United States?

options.A: The money supply is backed by gold reserves.
options.B: The least liquid measure of money is M2.
options.D: The most liquid measure of money is M1.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - The most liquid measure of money is M1.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following statements about a price ceiling is accurate?

options.A: An effective price ceiling must be at a price below the equilibrium price.
options.B: A price ceiling will increase the quantity of the good supplied.
options.C: A price ceiling will cause a shift in the demand curve for the good.
options.D: A price ceiling will have no effect on the quantity of the good supplied.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - An effective price ceiling must be at a price below the equilibrium price.

questions.stem_text:
When the United States places an import quota on imported sugar we expect which of the
following effects?

options.A: Consumers seek substitutes for sugar and products that use sugar.
options.B: Consumers consume more sugar and products that use sugar.
options.D: Net exports in the United States fall.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Consumers seek substitutes for sugar and products that use sugar.

questions.stem_text: Economists use the term "capital" to mean

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is most likely to produce stronger economic growth over time?

options.A: More rapid consumption of natural resources.
options.C: A falling stock of capital goods.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Investment tax credits.
